prior_experiments: NRF-06 new-input transfer on original model seeds
claim: Exploratory independent model-training seed replication of depth effect for fixed objective J=heldout_MSE+local_leakage^2

train.architecture: lsa.kappa_probe.ToyLoop with one tied ToyResidualBlock, two nn.Linear layers, tanh hidden nonlinearity
train.torch_manual_seed: Set to model seed before module construction
train.target: signed_permutation_batch task seeded by seed, source feature permutation randperm(128) using manual_seed(seed+17); signs rand(128)>0.5 using manual_seed(seed+29)
train.training_resources: Local CPU only; max four OS threads; no remote GPU, no expenditures
train.torch_version: record in result; use pinned API semantics and model weights SHA256
train.persisted_artifact: derived receipts and state_dict hashes; full trained checkpoint binaries optional and not pushed by default

eval.input_generator: LCG32 state=(1664525*state+1013904223) mod 2**32, every pair u,v draws one Box-Muller cos normal; initial state=(20261115+7919*task_seed+104729*fold) mod 2**32
eval.representation: State h_{R/2} after half the tied recurrence
eval.supervised_decoder: Train-only centered cross-covariance H^T(Y-mean Y), Gram-Schmidt 8 orthonormal rows
eval.nulls: One shifted-label projection, the first 8 coordinates, eight random projection bases with generator seed 400000+31*i+17*task_seed
eval.heldout_targets: First eight signed-permutation tanh teacher features
eval.leakage: Average on 12 shadow states of sqrt(sum_i ||(I-P)J_suffix^T u_i||_2^2/8) with basis rows u_i
eval.random_comparator: Median across eight complete random-arm J values (paired within checkpoint)

primary_final_checks.r16_supervised_wins: at least 3/3 of seeds at 4096 exposures
primary_final_checks.r32_random_wins: at least 3/3 of seeds at 4096 exposures

eval.secondary: At both exposures, compare supervised vs random MSE, leakage and J; no change in thresholds after inspecting results

provenance.dependent_math: patrickdugan/MathCan PR #46; generalized exact factor no-go in NRF-05

inference_boundary: Independent training seeds use the same synthetic teacher family and adopted post-hoc lambda. Any result is a small synthetic-model replication, not generalization to real Lean reasoning, architecture capability or safety.
